(TRIVALENT) # MACHINING: 3.2 # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.21 kg"}],"comment":"Note N1 specifies H7 holes with a ±0.02 mm tolerance, but note N5 calls for an I.Z.B.P. (trivalent zinc) plating finish without any allowance for the added coating thickness on those tight-tolerance holes. The plating will reduce the hole size and can cause mating pins or fasteners to fail to assemble; the designer should add a note specifying that H7 holes are to be reamed after plating or that pre-plate machining limits must account for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating that H7 holes shall be machined to allow for plating thickness, or that holes are to be reamed/tapped after the I.Z.B.P. surface treatment."}]}
